name: Default
shortDescription: Open source document e-signature platform for preparing PDFs, requesting signatures and keeping audit trails, backed by MongoDB.

alerts.message: The first visitor is sent to the admin setup page and creates the administrator account, so open the app right after deploying.
Signature requests and signer verification codes are sent by email. Set SMTP_ENABLE to true and fill in the SMTP_* variables, then redeploy.
Documents are signed with a self-signed certificate generated on first start, so PDF readers will not show them as trusted. A certificate from an AATL-approved authority is needed for that.
